design: Four fixed centres/densities; widths (0.08,0.08,0.12) versus (0.008,0.8,0.12), same covariance determinant. Exact and perturbed starts; clean and noisy observations. Same truth-based geometry prior within each shape.
limitations: 16 development fits; one noise draw, one perturbation, two designed shapes.
Shape change alters support, sampling and angular signal strength as well as conditioning; not an isolated causal manipulation of numerical condition number.
Oracle geometry priors and starts are not deployable initialization.
Noise SD is 5% of acquired clean RMS for each shape/window; absolute noise differs. Clean fits retain the same positive likelihood scale.
Voxel errors are on a fixed sampled field only, not continuous full-space error.
Exact truth is not a stationary point of the zero-mean density-regularized objective.
